question: Why is the fierce Raudreśvarī goddess especially esteemed by the supreme teachers?
premises: Raudreśvarī is the fierce goddess who has arrived.
Her arrival makes her desired by supreme teachers.
Supreme teachers value this fierce manifestation.
inference: Raudreśvarī is esteemed because her fierce presence is sought by the highest teachers.
uncertainties: The specific context of her arrival is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: The fierce Raudreśvarī, who has come forth, is therefore desired by the best of teachers.
